Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Daior Moran: 22-year-old woman, 152 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-2-light. Face: long narrow face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, long-loose, deliberate accent: strong split-length construction. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive but nonmagical geometric tattoo language across both arms; a carved belt buckle. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
